primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: To evaluate the 28-day mortality rate of ruxolitinib 5 mg BID + SoC therapy and ruxolitinib 15 mg BID + SoC compared with placebo + SoC therapy, in participants with COVID-19-associated ARDS who require mechanical ventilation.

groups.description: Ruxolitinib 15mg was administered BID approximately 12 hours apart without regard to food/feeding via enteric feeding tube or oral.
groups.title: Ruxolitininb 15mg + Standard of Care (SoC)

groups.description: Ruxolitinib 5mg was administered BID approximately 12 hours apart without regard to food/feeding via enteric feeding tube or oral.
groups.title: Ruxolitinib 5mg + Standard of Care (SoC)

groups.description: Matching Placebo was administered BID approximately 12 hours apart without regard to food/feeding via enteric feeding tube or oral.
groups.title: Placebo + Standard of Care (SoC)
